name: The Working Woman's Guide to Burning Bridges
source:
What happens when you're the toxic one in the relationship? In every relationship?

Play as an unreliable narrator and all-around hot mess, reeling from recent heartbreak and the general stress of corporate life. A new job, patient friends, a cat (or three), and a drink (or three) MIGHT be enough to help you change your ways... but old habits can be hard to break.

Is it possible to heal your broken heart without leaving a trail of burnt bridges in your wake? 

[from [url=https://shanchou.itch.io/notome]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果感情中有毒的那个人是你呢？如果每一段关系都如此呢？

你将扮演一个不可靠的叙述者，生活处处一团糟，还在近期失恋与职场压力的双重打击中摇摇欲坠。一份新工作、耐心的朋友、一只（或者三只）猫，以及一杯（或者三杯）酒，或许足以帮你改变…可积习总是难改。

你能否治愈破碎的心，同时不把沿途的人际关系全都毁掉？

[摘自[url=https://shanchou.itch.io/notome]itch.io[/url]]
